reasoning_content: The token endpoint is working now, so I need to check the token expiry and investigate why the delete operation failed with a 401 error—the admin token should be valid for longer. I'm wondering if there's a conflict with the `probe` client that was created during my earlier 409 response attempt, even though the error message was cut off. The admin token should be valid for over an hour, so the 401 on DELETE is puzzling. Let me debug this by checking the token's expiration time and retrying the delete operation to see if there's an authentication issue.

action.command:
TOK=$(curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:8080/realms/master/protocol/openid-connect/token" -d "client_id=admin-cli" -d "grant_type=password" -d "username=admin" -d "password=admin" | jq -r .access_token) && echo $TOK > /tmp/kc-token.txt && echo "$TOK" | cut -d. -f2 | tr -d '
' | base64 -d 2>/dev/null | jq '{exp, iat}'; echo "current epoch: $(date +%s)"; PROBE_ID=$(curl -s "http://localhost:8080/admin/realms/my-realm/clients" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK" | jq -r '.[] | select(.clientId=="probe2") | .id') && echo "probe2 id: $PROBE_ID" && curl -s -X DELETE "http://localhost:8080/admin/realms/my-realm/clients/$PROBE_ID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK" -w "
HTTP:%{http_code}
"

tool_call.arguments: {"command": "TOK=$(curl -s -X POST \"http://localhost:8080/realms/master/protocol/openid-connect/token\" -d \"client_id=admin-cli\" -d \"grant_type=password\" -d \"username=admin\" -d \"password=admin\" | jq -r .access_token) && echo $TOK > /tmp/kc-token.txt && echo \"$TOK\" | cut -d. -f2 | tr -d '\\n' | base64 -d 2>/dev/null | jq '{exp, iat}'; echo \"current epoch: $(date +%s)\"; PROBE_ID=$(curl -s \"http://localhost:8080/admin/realms/my-realm/clients\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOK\" | jq -r '.[] | select(.clientId==\"probe2\") | .id') && echo \"probe2 id: $PROBE_ID\" && curl -s -X DELETE \"http://localhost:8080/admin/realms/my-realm/clients/$PROBE_ID\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOK\" -w \"\\nHTTP:%{http_code}\\n\"", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Retry probe2 deletion with fresh token"}
